entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • IDE0380 removes required unsafe modifier from explicit-layout fields under updated memory-safety rules #84564
  • EmitFieldLoad possibly uses over-optimistic optimization for scenario when field's value isn't used #84563
  • Hot Reload (EnC): NullReferenceException in `DefinitionMap.GetPreviousMethodHandle` deleting a delta-added source-generated method (MAUI XAML SourceGen `UpdateComponent`) #84560

Closed

  • [LSP] [textDocument/rename] issue with source generated files #83826
  • Emit more efficient null check in inline-array helpers #84518
    18.10
  • Labeled break/continue: public API ready for review #84284
    18.10

PullRequests

Created

  • Adjust/add unions tests #84565
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions

Merged

  • Restore solution as a whole on auto-load instead of per-project #84202
    VSCode
  • Update analyzer rules docs stuff #84481
    VSCode
  • Clean up and ultimately remove LanguageServerFeatureOptions #84559
    Area-Razor
  • Fix linked editing for empty tag pairs #84562
    Area-Razor
  • Enable publishing for MVU demo branch #84551

    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Implement LSP daemon mode #84199
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Optimize DecisionDagBuilder with Tests.ValueSet for large or-patterns #83513

  • Reduce lsp server allocations by ~70% during load of already restored projects #84205
    VSCode
  • Fix: LINQ implicit anonymous type property allows ref structs, causing runtime TypeLoadException #84485
  • Extract file-based app entry point heuristic #84385
    VSCode

    Area-Compilers, Community
